request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Chaincoil Wraith".

Creative brief
Name: Chaincoil Wraith
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A floating controller that creates rotating chains of linked projectiles.
Body and silhouette: Hooded upper torso fading into a hanging spiral of chain links instead of legs.
Signature features: Empty hood, glowing wrist shackles, and a circular chain halo.
Palette and materials: Smoke gray, blackened iron, ember red, and faint brass.
Movement personality: Drifting, restrained, and ominously deliberate.
Attack concept: Raises one shackle and releases a curved row of linked iron sparks that slowly rotates around its casting point.
Directional details: A broken link hangs below the right wrist.
Avoid: Detailed ghost face, medieval prisoner with normal legs, chain pattern too dense to dodge.
